says: The pages this observatory publishes in the language, beside the engine's: the whole, and a page for each place it has in view - what is around it. Each row is a page: where it is written, what it looks through, and the thing it is the page of.
What the Open Commons Observatory shows first: why each star exists and how far it has come, then what is showing and has come to nothing yet, then every other lens in view.
How work is done here: each practice, why it is so, and where it is shown in what was decided - read by any driver, added to as a way of working is settled.
